tasks.title: Future you

hints.spaces: "In five years: " already ends with a space before the closing speech mark. + doesn't add any spaces of its own.

hints.other: sweets / 2 uses two ints, so the remainder is dropped. sweets / 2.0 keeps the decimal part.

tasks.title: Double trouble

hints.compile: Replace every ___ first. Line 1 needs int.Parse, * means times, + means add, and you print the variable answer.
hints.other: Check each step: int.Parse first, then * 2, then + 10, then print answer.

tasks.title: Tuck shop

hints.compile: C# doesn't know change yet. Before the Console.WriteLine line, make the box: int change = money - price;
hints.spaces: Keep the space before the closing speech mark in "Your change is " and after the opening one in " pounds".

hints.compile: Did you use int.Parse(Console.ReadLine()) for both numbers? Does every line end with a semicolon?
hints.spaces: + doesn't add spaces. Put a space inside the speech marks: "The total cost is " and " pounds".
hints.other: Adults cost 8 each and children 5 each: adults * 8 + children * 5.
